Coach's note, athletics club.
Vedant came to me after Thursday's practice with a question: his knee felt sore after sprints, and should he keep training? He said he had read three different answers online and they all disagreed.
I told him I could plan his sessions, but a question about a sore knee was one for a doctor, and I would not guess. I asked him to watch from the side that day and to tell his mother.
On Saturday he told me he had booked a visit with Dr Dilnaz and would bring me whatever she said about training. I have put the knee question on hold until then.
Irawati, coach

passage:
Wednesday

My shins have been aching after every sprint practice for two weeks. Last night I watched loads of videos. One said ice, one said heat, one said "run through it," one said buy special insoles. They can't all be right. And I'm not a doctor, and neither are most of those people. So today I did something different. I told Coach Swati after practice. She listened, watched me run, and said my shoes were worn out and I was landing hard. Then she said, "If it keeps hurting, see a doctor, not the internet." Mummy took me to the doctor this evening. The doctor checked my legs and said to rest for now and see how it feels. — Zubin
